sources.title: Flux 3 — Multimodal AI by Black Forest Labs | Real World Models
sources.snippet: Black Forest Labs' new multimodal foundation model jointly learns from images, videos, and audio within a unified architecture — because visual intelligence requires understanding how objects hold together, how things move, and how events sound.
